Overview

Four prediction mechanisms

The categories identify what each prediction is associated with: an observation, a spatial query, a regular grid cell, or an element of a 3D set.

I

View-indexed

Predict quantities associated with input pixels or patches.

 II

Spatial query

Evaluate conditional fields at points or along rays.

 III

Regular-grid-indexed

Predict field values or primitives at regular grid cells.

 IV

Irregular 3D sets

Generate or update primitives in a set of scene elements.

Research directions

Geometric constraints, reliable completion, long-range reconstruction, adaptive computation, and improving robustness.

What the comparisons show

The prediction unit determines where models use and reuse computation. The measured results show how these choices play out under specific observation budgets and tasks.
